how_to_requalify.note: Pipe tests spawn their own child BridgeMain JVMs with FORGE_ENGINE_SHA bound; no display, no network.

global_gates.rules_authority: Forge Rules-Core alone determines legality, costs, mana, stack, priority, targets, combat, triggers, layers, SBAs, zones, copy/control and Rules randomness. The bridge never decides.
global_gates.no_second_engine: PASS: all option sets derive from native controller callbacks and Core-owned enumerations (TargetRestrictions, getAllPossibleAbilities, ManaPool).
global_gates.no_ai_authority: PASS: testAllControllersExternalNoAi pins every seat to ExternalPlayerController; forge-ai is never consulted.
global_gates.no_gui_defaults: PASS: HeadlessGuiFailClosedTest pins all 8 choice-bearing GUI entries to throw; no GUI default reaches a decision.
global_gates.no_requested_option_filtering: PASS: per-family exact option counts (modes 7, routes 2, targets 2, exile 3, orders 2) plus wrong-actor/stale/unknown negatives on every key frame, in-process and over the pipe.
global_gates.principal_scoping: PASS: actor-only options (WRONG_ACTOR over pipe), foe hands all <hidden>, outsider legal_actions empty, R9 next-decision withholding, event export fails closed.
global_gates.rng: PASS with single-flight caveat: per-session MyRandom seed binding, same-seed twins equal in-process and over the pipe, distinct-seed controls differ. Concurrent seeded games in one process are not deterministic by engine design.
global_gates.replay: NOT CLAIMED: export_replay fails closed by design (replay_supported=false).
global_gates.credit_basis: name-only diff vs audit base outside forge-protocol2-bridge/ is empty; no Forge Rules-Core production edits.
